title: Sequential algorithm for structural estimations with equilibrium constraints
abstract: arXiv:2606.04356v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This study examines sequential algorithms with the Zero Jacobian Property (ZJP) for estimating structural models subject to equilibrium constraints. For Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) and the Generalized Method of Moments (GMM), the current study shows that these algorithms attain fast (near-quadratic) local convergence in large samples to the solution of the constrained optimization problem. If consistent initial estimates of the parameters satisfying a suitable rate condition are available, the algorithms yield an asymptotically efficient estimator even after one iteration.   It then proposes a novel algorithm called the Sequential Linearly Constrained (SLC) algorithm, which is applicable to a broader class of structural models than existing methods. translated_title: 具有均衡约束的结构估计的序贯算法
translated_abstract: 本研究考察了具有零雅可比性质的序贯算法，用于估计受均衡约束的结构模型。对于极大似然估计（MLE）和广义矩估计（GMM），本研究表明这些算法在大样本中对约束优化问题的解实现了快速（近二次）局部收敛。如果存在满足适当速率条件的一致初始参数估计，即使仅迭代一次，这些算法也能产生渐近有效的估计量。随后，本研究提出了一种名为序贯线性约束（SLC）算法的新型算法，该算法适用于比现有方法更广泛的结构模型类别。SLC算法的一个关键优势在于，它可以在无需显式计算均衡约束雅可比矩阵的情况下实施，并且速度可比现有方法快数倍。
tldr: 本文提出具有零雅可比性质的序贯算法及新型序贯线性约束（SLC）算法，用于带均衡约束的结构模型估计，不仅实现快速局部收敛和渐近有效性，而且无需显式计算雅可比矩阵并能适用于更广泛的结构模型类别。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes sequential algorithms with the Zero Jacobian Property and a novel Sequential Linearly Constrained (SLC) algorithm for estimating structural models with equilibrium constraints, achieving near-quadratic local convergence and asymptotic efficiency while requiring no explicit Jacobian computation and applying to a broader class of structural models.
